name: South Lake Aquapark
description: A playground on OpenStreetMap near Southoe. No council list we've checked includes it yet, so we can't confirm it's open to everyone or what it has. OpenStreetMap says there may be a charge to use it.
notConfirmed: Exact position (taken from OpenStreetMap), age ranges, play equipment (what is mapped on OpenStreetMap, which may be incomplete), opening hours, toilets and parking. Listed from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors) only, so whether it is open to the public is unconfirmed too.
